stem.text: Group 2 elements and their compounds show trends in their physical and chemical properties. Barium is above radium in Group 2 of the Periodic Table.
Which statements are likely to be correct?

items: Barium hydroxide is less soluble than radium hydroxide.
Barium reacts less vigorously with water than radium does.
Barium sulfate is more soluble than radium sulfate.
